## Experience purpose
What player experience or narrative beat does this change serve?

## Game-design impact
- [ ] No gameplay truth changed.
- [ ] Gameplay truth changed and canonical docs were updated.

## Anti-hand-holding review
- [ ] No solution is revealed through labels, colors, helper text, arrows, or obvious highlighting.

## Live demo check
- [ ] Relevant screen renders full-screen.
- [ ] Happy path works.
- [ ] Incorrect lock input does not dead-end the session.
- [ ] Reset remains possible when applicable.

## Testing choice
Explain only if automated tests were added. Broad test coverage is not required for the pilot.
